digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 24 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 15 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: affaan-m/ECC
repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencod
repos.summary_zh: 为Claude Code等AI编码工具装上性能优化系统，用技能、记忆与安全机制让Agent更可靠

repos.name: punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers
repos.description: A collection of MCP servers.
repos.summary_zh: 九万四千星标的 MCP 服务器精选清单，一站式解决 AI 工具生态选型难题

repos.name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台热点聚合加深度验证的AI调研技能，让Agent输出带来源的可靠结论

repos.name: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
repos.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
repos.summary_zh: 给 AI 编码代理装上 Chrome 开发者工具，让 Agent 能直接调试网页、查控制台、看网络请求

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: unclecode/crawl4ai
repos.description: 🚀🤖 Crawl4AI: Open-source LLM Friendly Web Crawler & Scraper. Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/jP8KfhDhyN
repos.summary_zh: 开源 LLM 友好的爬虫框架，专为 AI 应用抓取网页并输出干净 Markdown 数据

repos.name: mlc-ai/web-llm
repos.description: High-performance In-browser LLM Inference Engine
repos.summary_zh: 浏览器内直接跑大模型的高性能推理引擎，无需服务器即可实现端侧AI应用

repos.name: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
repos.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
repos.summary_zh: 浏览器里的真实间谍卫星模拟器，用实况数据在逼真3D地球上做开源空间情报分析

repos.name: stalwartlabs/stalwart
repos.description: All-in-one Mail & Collaboration server. Secure, scalable and fluent in every protocol (IMAP, JMAP, SMTP, CalDAV, CardDAV, WebDAV).
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的全能邮件协作服务器，一套部署搞定 IMAP、JMAP、SMTP 与 CalDAV 等全部协议

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: colinhacks/zod
repos.description: TypeScript-first schema validation with static type inference
repos.summary_zh: TypeScript 优先的运行时数据校验库，自动推导静态类型，让前后端共享同一套安全模型

repos.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
repos.summary_zh: 聚合34家免费大模型API共635个接口，统一为OpenAI格式并智能路由故障转移，月省74亿Token

repos.name: amitshekhariitbhu/llm-inference-engineering
repos.description: Learn LLM Inference Engineering step by step - from KV cache, PagedAttention, and continuous batching to vLLM, SGLang, and GPUs.
repos.summary_zh: 从 KV cache 到 vLLM 的 LLM 推理优化全链路教程，手把手带你吃透高性能部署核心

repos.name: XHToken/Spark-X2.5
repos.description: Spark-x2.5 open model series. Pushing the Limits of Agentic Capabilities in On-Device Models
repos.summary_zh: 端侧智能体模型新标杆，主打轻量部署下强化Agent规划与工具调用能力

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: jingyaogong/minimind
repos.description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
repos.summary_zh: 从零训练仅6.4亿参数大模型只需两小时，手把手教学极低成本入门LLM底层原理

repos.name: google-research/timesfm
repos.description: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting.
repos.summary_zh: 谷歌开源的时间序列预测基础模型，零样本即可精准预测，超越多数专有模型

repos.name: MakazhanAlpamys/Soup
repos.description: Fine-tune LLMs from one YAML. Layer streaming trains an 8B model on a 4 GB laptop GPU.
repos.summary_zh: 一份 YAML 配置即可微调大模型，流式分层训练让 8B 模型跑在 4GB 显存笔记本上

repos.name: pollen-robotics/microduck_rl
repos.description: RL training environments for Microduck (mjlab)
repos.summary_zh: 强化学习训练Microduck四足机器人的仿真环境，基于MJLab实现高效策略迁移，让机器人学会敏捷运动

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: emilk/egui
repos.description: egui: an easy-to-use immediate mode GUI in Rust that runs on both web and native
repos.summary_zh: Rust 即时模式 GUI 库，一套代码原生与网页双端运行，界面刷新简单直接

repos.name: coleam00/Archon
repos.description: The first open-source harness builder for AI coding. Make AI coding deterministic and repeatable.
repos.summary_zh: 开源 AI 编码工作流编排框架，让 AI 编程从随机输出变为可复现的确定性流程

repos.name: nashsu/llm_wiki
repos.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of t
repos.summary_zh: 自动将文档编织成交互知识图谱的桌面应用，免去传统 RAG 检索步骤，让 AI 直接基于关联上下文作答

repos.name: rmyndharis/OpenWA
repos.description: Free, Open Source, Self-Hosted WhatsApp API Gateway
repos.summary_zh: 自托管 WhatsApp API 网关，免费开源替代官方方案，支持多设备连接与消息自动化

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: 3b1b/manim
repos.description: Animation engine for explanatory math videos
repos.summary_zh: 用代码生成数学动画的引擎，让复杂公式变成直观视觉故事，3B1B 同款神器

repos.name: abi/screenshot-to-code
repos.description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
repos.summary_zh: 截图直接变前端代码，支持HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue，7.7万星标的设计稿转码神器

repos.name: starship/starship
repos.description: ☄🌌️ The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt for any shell!
repos.summary_zh: 跨 shell 通用的极速提示符，开箱即用且支持无限自定义，让终端状态一目了然

repos.name: rust-unofficial/awesome-rust
repos.description: A curated list of Rust code and resources.
repos.summary_zh: Rust 生态资源大全，从入门到进阶一页速查，开发者必备的宝藏清单

papers.title: Legibility is Not Interpretability: Comparing Judged and Actual Importance in Chain-Of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reasoning traces from chain-of-thought models appear to offer a legible window into how a model arrives at its answer. A growing body of work treats them as such, using LLM judges to diagnose errors,
papers.summary_zh: 揭示思维链可读性不等于可解释性，提出判断重要性与实际重要性分离的评估框架，发现大模型裁判标注与真实归因一致性不足四成

papers.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) combines student-generated rollouts with dense token-level supervision from a teacher. Existing work has mainly studied its algorithmic behavior, leaving the role of train
papers.summary_zh: 通过单查询训练揭示策略蒸馏中数据量的关键作用，证明极简数据即可触发有效学习，挑战传统数据规模假设并简化训练流程

papers.title: Sequential Beats Joint: On the Interplay between On-Policy Distillation and RLVR
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have emerged as two dominant methods for post-training reasoning LLMs. Prior work uses OPD's dense token-level su
papers.summary_zh: 提出顺序式在线策略蒸馏优于联合式融合，以密集令牌监督补充稀疏强化奖励，显著提升推理模型训练效率与性能

papers.title: Robust PAC Learning of Concurrent Stochastic Games
papers.abstract: We introduce the first Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning framework for general-sum concurrent stochastic games (CSGs) with transition uncertainty, while addressing the challenge of Nash eq
papers.summary_zh: 提出首个面向一般和并发随机博弈的PAC学习框架，以数据驱动L1置信集处理转移不确定性并保证纳什均衡存在性

papers.title: Knowledge Acquisition During Pre-training? Large Language Models Learn Better With Auxiliary Views
papers.abstract: Gaps remain in our understanding of how large language models (LLMs) acquire knowledge during pre-training. We posit that auxiliary views, reformulations of knowledge, are causally helpful for learnin
papers.summary_zh: 通过受控实验证明辅助视图能促进预训练知识获取，相比纯重复数据，加入知识改写可使下游任务准确率提升约百分之五

papers.title: Para-Pipe: Exploiting Hierarchical Operator Parallelism of ML Computational Graphs on SoCs
papers.abstract: As edge-based deep learning applications become more complex, optimizing performance on heterogeneous System-on-Chips (SoCs) presents unique challenges. Traditional pipelining techniques distributing
papers.summary_zh: 提出层级算子并行调度方法Para-Pipe，在异构SoC上实现计算图多级流水线协同，吞吐量较传统方案提升最高达2.6倍且资源利用率更优

papers.title: A Case Study on Emergent Cheating and Whistleblowing in Autonomous Research Swarms
papers.abstract: Multi-agent AI science ecosystems rely on agents possessing tools that allow them to communicate, coordinate, and build on each other's work. Yet this shared infrastructure can also introduce vulnerab
papers.summary_zh: 提出多智能体科研集群涌现性作弊与告发机制研究框架，揭示共享工具链可致不良行为传染，并验证告发行为能有效抑制作弊扩散的系统性风险

papers.title: SWE-Gate: Passing Functional Tests Is Not Enough for Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract: Repository-level software engineering benchmarks have significantly advanced the evaluation of coding agents, but existing benchmarks primarily measure whether generated patches pass functional tests
papers.summary_zh: 提出SWE-Gate基准揭示仅过功能测试不足以评估编码智能体，引入评审约束指标使通过率下降达40%，为软件工程智能体提供更严格评测标准

papers.title: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
papers.abstract: As terminal-based code agents become prevalent, agent trajectories have accumulated at scale, while realistic, executable environments remain scarce. However, environments are what agent post-training
papers.summary_zh: 提出终端宇宙方法将智能体轨迹转化为可扩展终端环境，每个环境可生成多任务并支持执行反馈，缓解真实环境稀缺问题

papers.title: Clean Engineering, Unstable Measurement: A Preregistered Reliability Failure of Black-Box LLM Observers on Shared Endpoints
papers.abstract: Language-model judges now gate training data, score generations, and drive leaderboards. The judge is then a measurement instrument, resting on one rarely stated assumption: the same request, sent to
papers.summary_zh: 审计黑盒大模型裁判在共享端点上的测量稳定性，预注册实验揭示同一请求次日重测即出现显著评分漂移，证明其不可靠并挑战现有评测基准假设

papers.title: One Editor, Many Edits: A Unified Training-Free Framework for Diverse Video Editing
papers.abstract: Video editing spans diverse editing paradigms, yet achieving high-quality instruction-guided and subject-guided editing within a single unified framework remains challenging. We introduce EditVid, a t
papers.summary_zh: 提出免训练统一视频编辑框架EditVid，融合稀疏因果记忆与对应关系后处理，同时支持指令与主体引导编辑，无需微调即可实现多样编辑任务的高质量结果

papers.title: Seeing Before Synthesizing: VLM-Guided Transition Event Discovery for Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning
papers.abstract: Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning aims to localize and describe multiple events in untrimmed videos given only an ordered set of event-level captions per video. Recent work synthesizes auxiliar
papers.summary_zh: 提出视觉语言模型引导的过渡事件发现方法，利用视觉信息合成过渡字幕，在弱监督密集视频描述任务中显著提升事件定位与描述准确性

papers.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
papers.abstract: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a prov
papers.summary_zh: 提出编译即训练范式，将自然语言规范转化为本地神经函数，免去远程模型调用，实现零延迟低成本推理且保持高精度

papers.title: ESPO: Error-Structured Prompt Optimization via Diagnose, Diversify, and Stabilize
papers.abstract: Evolutionary prompt optimizers such as GEPA suffer from prompt bloat: each iteration appends rules and caveats, producing prompts up to 3$\times$ longer yet no more accurate. We trace this to three de
papers.summary_zh: 针对进化提示优化中的提示膨胀问题，提出诊断、多样化与稳定三阶段错误结构化框架，在保持精度的同时将提示长度压缩至三分之一

papers.title: A Computationally Feasible Framework for Causal Probabilistic Explanation
papers.abstract: Explaining why a specific outcome occurred, and which inputs deserve the blame or credit, is central to philosophical, scientific, and policy analysis. Existing tools split into two camps. The theory
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向因果概率解释的计算可行框架，将实际因果判定从玩具模型扩展至大规模系统，计算复杂度降低数个量级并保持判定准确性
